blurb: Misty Hill Farm offers full service horse boarding with amenities including 12 x 12 stalls with fans, large pastures with run in sheds, outdoor and indoor arenas, and facilities such as wash stall, laundry, bathroom, and tack room. Boarding options include stall board, pasture board, and retirement boarding with daily care and feeding. The farm is managed by a veterinarian and located near Chapel Hill, Carrboro, and Durham.
